CPL, CPS và CPA khác nhau thế nào?: What's the difference between CPL, CPS and CPA?
CPL trả theo hồ sơ được duyệt, ví dụ mở: CPL pays per approved application, e.g. a credit card sign-up. CPS pays per successful sale or loan. CPA pays when the customer completes a specific action such as signing an insurance policy or opening an account.
